# sophosfirewall_static_route (Resource)

Manages an IPv4 unicast static route (*Configure > Routing > Static routes*). Set `gateway`, `interface` or both; use `interface = "Blackhole"` for a blackhole route. When both are set the gateway must be on the interface's network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reach a branch office network through a next-hop router on Port1.
resource "sophosfirewall_static_route" "branch" {
  name        = "branch-office"
  description = "Branch office LAN"
  destination = "192.168.10.0/24"
  gateway     = "172.16.16.1"
  interface   = "Port1"
  metric      = 10
}

# Drop traffic to a network (blackhole route).
resource "sophosfirewall_static_route" "sinkhole" {
  name        = "sinkhole"
  destination = "198.51.100.0/24"
  interface   = "Blackhole"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Destination network in CIDR notation, e.g. `192.168.10.0/24`. Use a `/32` for a host route.
- `name` (String) Unique name of the static route. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `administrative_distance` (Number) Administrative distance (1-255); lower values are preferred. Defaults to `1`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `gateway` (String) Next-hop IPv4 address.
- `interface` (String) Name of the outgoing interface, e.g. `Port1`, or `Blackhole` to drop matching traffic.
- `metric` (Number) Routing metric (0-255). Defaults to `0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_static_route.example <name-or-uuid>
```
